description: This Java source file defines the CommandSourceService class, which handles transactional processing of commands in a two-phase approach, including saving initial command sources, processing command results, error handling, and sanitization of command JSON data. It interacts with repositories, handlers, and configurations to manage command lifecycle and enforcement of maker-checker workflows.

classes.name: CommandSourceService
classes.description: A service class that manages the lifecycle and processing of command sources, including creation, transaction management, result handling, error reporting, and sanitization procedures.

methods.name: saveInitialNewTransaction
methods.description: Creates and saves a new command source in a new transaction with repeatable read isolation level.

methods.name: saveInitialSameTransaction
methods.description: Creates and saves a new command source within the current transaction.

methods.name: saveInitial
methods.description: Core method to create and persist the initial command source, handling unique constraint exceptions for idempotency.

methods.name: saveResultNewTransaction
methods.description: Persists the command result in a new transaction.

methods.name: saveResultSameTransaction
methods.description: Persists the command result in the current transaction.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Internal method to save the command source entity to database.

methods.name: generateErrorInfo
methods.description: Converts an exception into a user-friendly error info object.

methods.name: getCommandSource
methods.description: Retrieves a command source by ID, throwing if not found.

methods.name: findCommandSource
methods.description: Finds a command source based on action, entity, and idempotency key.

methods.name: getInitialCommandSource
methods.description: Constructs a new command source from provided command wrapper and JSON, marking it as under processing and sanitizing the JSON content.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the execution of a command via a handler, managing maker-checker workflow and transaction rollbacks.

methods.name: sanitizeJson
methods.description: Sanitizes sensitive fields in the command JSON based on provided keys or masks all if specified.
